source: https://evisa.gov.vn/e-visa/foreigners (form fields and the front-end checks in its step-1 and validation modules, read 2026-10-15); https://thithucdientu.gov.vn is the Vietnamese-language twin

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Printed on the photo page. Capital letters and digits only, up to 20. The e-visa form warns you to check the number when it is not 8 or 9 characters.

errors.tooShort: Enter the passport number from the photo page
errors.tooLong: Passport number too long — max 20 characters
errors.invalidChars: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols
errors.invalidFormat: Capital letters and digits only, up to 20

full_name.label: Full name (as in passport)
full_name.help: Exactly as on the passport's machine-readable (ICAO) line, surname first. The form has two boxes, Surname and Middle and given name, up to 50 characters each, letters and spaces only, and it turns them into capitals. If the passport shows only one name, it goes in the given-name box.

errors.tooLong: Each name box on the form takes up to 50 characters
errors.invalidChars: Only Latin characters allowed, no special characters

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: DD/MM/YYYY, as the e-visa calendar shows it. It cannot be later than today. If you only know the year, the form has a year-only option.

errors.tooEarly: Date of birth seems too far in the past — double check
errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

passport_expiry.label: Passport expiry date
passport_expiry.help: DD/MM/YYYY. The e-visa form rejects an expired passport and needs it valid at least 30 days past the e-visa end date. Keep at least 6 months of validity after your planned arrival.

intended_arrival.label: Intended date of entry
intended_arrival.help: DD/MM/YYYY — when you plan to enter Vietnam. The e-visa's own valid-from and valid-to dates are two more boxes on the form, at most 90 days apart and not before today.

errors.required: Intended date of entry is required
errors.tooLate: Date too far in the future

port_of_entry.label: Intended border gate of entry
port_of_entry.placeholder: Tan Son Nhat Int Airport (Ho Chi Minh City)
port_of_entry.help: Picked from the form's list of airports, land border gates and seaports. Search by gate name, e.g. Tan Son or Noi Bai; IATA codes like SGN are not in the names.

purpose_of_entry.label: Purpose of entry
purpose_of_entry.help: Tourism, business, transit, family visit, study, etc.

accommodation.label: Address in Vietnam
accommodation.placeholder: Hotel Example, 123 Nguyen Hue, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City
accommodation.help: First night's address. Hotel name + street + city is enough.

email.label: Email
email.help: Approval letter and e-visa PDF are sent here. Up to 100 characters; you type it twice, and the confirm box does not accept pasting.

errors.invalidFormat: Email wrong format — check the address
